events.title: Scenario: AI compute concentration raises local transformer demand
events.summary: Concentrated AI and data-center siting may produce localized transformer loading spikes and accelerate replacement demand. If sustained, this pattern would increase procurement urgency and strain manufacturer delivery schedules.

events.title: Scenario: HVDC lines as a modular response to offshore renewables limits
events.summary: Modular HVDC offers a pathway to link offshore renewables, but converter manufacturing and installation capacity could become the gating factor for scaled adoption. Phased deployments may create integration and commissioning complexity.

events.title: Scenario: Transformer manufacturing and critical-minerals linkages tighten
events.summary: Critical-mineral and component supply signals are creating potential constraints for large transformer manufacturing. Persistent constraints would increase delivery uncertainty and incentivize design or procurement adaptations.

events.title: Scenario: Local manufacturing push reshapes EPC timelines
events.summary: Local manufacturing interest could reduce lead times for certain substation modules, but scaling capacity and workforce readiness are key constraints. Hybrid sourcing is a plausible near-term path.

events.title: Scenario: Battery energy storage firms seen as key partners for data-center resilience
events.summary: Data-center adoption of battery storage could lower peak grid stress locally and change resilience procurement profiles, but storage supply constraints introduce new vectors of delivery risk.

events.title: Scenario: Transmission constraints lead to localized solar curtailment pressure
events.summary: Transmission capacity constraints could force localized solar curtailment in high-resource areas if upgrades lag deployment. This creates near-term operational and commercial pressure for developers and grid planners.

events.title: Scenario: Lithium flow and battery manufacturing linkage strengthens
events.summary: Increased lithium supply and local battery manufacturing capacity could ease storage and inverter pressures over time, but their impact on high-voltage equipment lead times will be limited in the short term.

events.title: Scenario: Procurement complexity elevates transformer and HV project risk
events.summary: More complex procurement requirements may lengthen lead times and concentrate supplier risk, increasing the chance of delivery delays for transformers and HV equipment. Adaptive procurement practices could mitigate but require deliberate policy choices.

events.title: Scenario: Grid-operational AI adoption increases optimization and cyber risk
events.summary: Adoption of AI in grid operations may deliver efficiency gains while increasing cybersecurity and governance requirements. The balance of benefits and risk depends on the pace of security and regulatory adaptation.

events.title: Scenario: Modular substation designs gain traction for extreme-weather resilience
events.summary: Modular substation designs may shorten field timelines and improve resilience to extreme weather, but require standardization and component availability to scale.
